title: primalucelib failed replies preceded by SESTO SENSO 3 debug text on the same line
summary: After quick repeated ARCO syncs the controller printed mJsonAPI_ParseCmdReq_Motor in front of the JSON reply on one line, which did not parse, so the request failed.

resolution.evidence: 20261023080442-7930-primaluce-arco-sestosenso3/verification.md: a reply line is parsed from its first brace; debug_text_before_a_reply_is_skipped and sestosenso3_rotator_sync pass and fail without the fix; hardware sync behind debug text ended OK. Retested on the tree merged with the audit repair (verification.md V10, V11).
